_comment: Declarative policy-as-code rules. Allowed conditions: passport -> category_in, approval, field_is_unknown; change -> access_mode_transition, approval; event -> action_mutating, approval. All conditions in a rule must hold. Nothing here is executed as code.

rules.title: Unapproved database MCP server
rules.explanation: The server's config shows explicit database evidence (package, image or command) and approvals.json has no approved record for this passport.

rules.title: Access mode downgraded to UNKNOWN after a config edit
rules.explanation: The confirmed passport had proven read-only access, but the edited config no longer carries that evidence. Access is now UNKNOWN until a human re-reviews it.

rules.title: Owner not attested
rules.explanation: No owner is declared in the config. AutoDiscover will not guess one, so accountability is missing.

rules.title: Version not attested
rules.explanation: No version is declared in the config, so the exact build in use cannot be pinned or audited.

rules.title: Mutating action without approval
rules.explanation: A consented runtime event shows a write/delete-type action that no approval record covers.
